keying: rows are keyed to the 22-member Representation union; `unions` says which rows are also members of the 21-member AST union the committed inventory enumerates, and the ACC-1 totality gate is stated over those

reasonCodes.CONSUMER-GATED: cheap to admit, no store meaning yet; admission waits for a real consumer
reasonCodes.INT-WIDTH: no bounded integer carrier fixes the width, and the Integer-semantics ruling — SafeInt bounds versus the bare isInt filter — settles the number rows first
reasonCodes.NO-RECONSTRUCTABLE-IDENTITY: Effect's persistent codec rejects or cannot restore it, so no faithful carriage exists
reasonCodes.PATTERN-HAZARD: regex-adjacent semantics; Effect's own importer refuses patterns for the same reason

boolean, number and string literals carried; a bigint literal waits with the BigInt row, and a null literal arrives as the Null keyword — the projection collapses it
increment C2: elements and their optionality carried, a rest of length zero or one carried as an Option; a longer rest and the empty tuple have no spelling on this side and die in the decoder
property signatures with string names, carried with their optionality; number and symbol names, the mutability bit and index signatures are increment C3 and are refused until it lands
increment C1: member order is identity, nothing flattens or deduplicates, both modes are carried and always spelled, and the empty union is Never and is refused at the gate
increment C4: string and safe-int members, source order is identity, member names pairwise distinct, member values deliberately free because TypeScript spells aliases
increment C-decl: the id is registry-gated and an id outside the registry is refused unknownDeclaration by name; payload shape and type-parameter count are read off the row

increment C6: the thunk is carried INLINE as a nested code, which is Effect's own shape, and the always-empty checks field needs no term. This is the GUARD the guardedness law is about — bareRefs stops here, so a cycle through a susp is admitted and one without is refused

increment C6: the references table is read now, and a reference is the name into it — the one admitted node with no checks key. The name is nonempty as Effect requires; the address discipline and resolvability are the door's and the materializer's, not WF's.
